item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 12:49 AM, 12 September 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Guiguinto, San Rafael, Angat, Pandi, Santa Maria, Meycauayan, Marilao, Balagtas, Bocaue, Bulakan, and Obando), Metro Manila (Valenzuela, Pasig, San Juan, Manila, Malabon, and Mandaluyong), Pampanga (Macabebe, Masantol, Candaba, Santa Ana, Mexico, San Fernando, Bacolor, Guagua, Santa Rita, and Sasmuan), Quezon (Infanta, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Pagbilao, Pitogo, Gumaca, Plaridel, Agdangan, and Unisan), Rizal (Tanay, Cainta, Baras, Morong, Teresa, and Taytay), and Tarlac (San Jose and Capas) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bulacan (Calumpit, Pulilan, Baliuag, Bustos, Plaridel, San Jose del Monte, and Norzagaray), Metro Manila (Quezon City, Marikina, and Caloocan), Pampanga (Santo Tomas, Minalin, San Simon, Apalit, and San Luis), Quezon (General Nakar), and Rizal (Rodriguez, San Mateo, and Antipolo) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 23 #NCRPRSD
